mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.train_id, g.segment_index, g.from_stop_order, g.to_stop_order, g.from_station_id, a.station_name AS from_station_name, g.to_station_id, b.station_name AS to_station_name, g.mileage FROM train_segment g LEFT JOIN station a ON a.id = g.from_station_id LEFT JOIN station b ON b.id = g.to_station_id WHERE g.train_id = #{trainId} ORDER BY g.segment_index
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO train_segment (train_id, segment_index, from_stop_order, to_stop_order, from_station_id, to_station_id, mileage) VALUES
(#{g.trainId}, #{g.segmentIndex}, #{g.fromStopOrder}, #{g.toStopOrder}, #{g.fromStationId}, #{g.toStationId}, #{g.mileage})
